messages.content: You are a skeptical senior ML security reviewer. Return JSON only. We are searching for one genuinely distinct, executable world-model security mechanism, not a paper idea. Novelty threshold is >=7/10 for an ICLR-scale claim. The attacker may contribute truthful, legal action sequences only; no labels, reward edits, gradients, parameters, checkpoints, prompts, API abuse, environment changes, or hidden metadata. The target is a shared world model used for planning. Existing released carriers we can run are TD-MPC2 mt30-48M (latent deterministic dynamics), MBRL-Lib/PETS (diagonal Gaussian MLP), and a small recurrent DreamerV3 codebase without a released checkpoint. Existing tests/rejections cover rollout compounding, uncertainty/variance, representation/SimNorm, negative transfer/distribution shift, Bellman/bootstrap, planner sampling/CEM, termination, private query leakage, cross-branch coupling, routing/prototype, generic TTT gradient bias, provenance/backdoors, and action-operator rotation. The current positive family is a legal cheetah-run action curriculum causing held-out walker-run short-horizon MPC loss after dynamics-only adaptation; it fails on cup-catch, walker-like tasks, and several controls, so do not merely rename it. We need a mechanism that is different and has a 2-minute native falsification gate with exact metrics and controls. Consider a recurrent latent carrier only if a minimal truthful native gate is realistic. Reject anything mathematically impossible in the listed architectures or requiring an unavailable large trainer. Include nearest prior and why not generic. If no candidate clears 7, return verdict REJECT_ALL.

{"request": "Find at most three candidates under the exact constraints. Prioritize a recurrent-state / absorbing-basin mechanism only if it is genuinely distinct from rollout compounding or backdoor behavior. For each candidate give: name, score, attack operation, invariant, released carrier, exact short gate, positive controls, nearest prior, why not generic, decision.", "round": "Round12 carrier-diverse search after native rejection of cross-counterfactual coupling."}
